subject: maths
question: A circular arc whose radius is 14 cm, makes an angle of 45º at the centre. Find the perimeter (in cm) of the sector. (Use π = 22/7)
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Arc Length = (45° ÷ 360°) × 2 × (22 ÷ 7) × 14 Arc Length = (1 ÷ 8) × 88 = 11 cm Perimeter of Sector = Arc Length + 2 × Radius Perimeter = 11 + 2 × 14 = 39 cm **∴ The correct answer is 39 cm.**
